Experimental PLATO is experimental: it is developed in the open and not yet fully tested, and its terms and schemas may change, or break, between releases. A renamed or withdrawn term is kept, marked as deprecated, for at least one release before it is removed. Each release is archived on Zenodo with its own DOI. PLATO tools has its own badge.
